_comment: Copy to config/wisp.local.json and fill in. That file is git-ignored: never commit it.

nextcloud._comment: Uploads go to the Mac on the tailnet, which forwards port 9001 to Nextcloud on the NAS (tailscale serve --bg --tcp 9001 tcp://<NAS LAN IP>:9001). tools/set_upload.py sends it to the board.
